_source: Real values from the live 'Jellytot · Brand' Figma variable collection (15 tokens), as documented in ~/Projects/Jellytot/docs/HANDOVER-brand-2026-07-28.md lines 53-59. Radius is NOT a decided brand fact yet (that question is still open as of 2026-07-30), so it is left at a neutral default rather than fabricated as settled. Font is the pairing named at line 91/329 of the same doc: PP Right Grotesk (sans, H1/body) + PP Acma (serif, H2) - PP Acma is not wired into this schema (only one display family + one mono slot exist here) so it is left as a documented gap, not silently dropped.
